name: 69 v5 ⑦mobile-19.5-9 背景满幅（拉伸锚点 + 构图覆盖）（bg cover ok w=1560 h=720）

asserts.source: local hit=nil for _,l in ipairs(query.logs()) do if l:find('bg cover ok',1,true) then hit=l end end assert(hit,'无 bg cover ok') local w=tonumber(hit:match('w=(%d+)')) local h=tonumber(hit:match('h=(%d+)')) assert(w==1560 and h==720, '画布尺寸不符 '..tostring(w)..'x'..tostring(h)) return true

note: 逐画布一条：mobile-19.5-9 期望 w=1560 h=720
